categories.main_business_segments: Shunya International operates three primary business segments: (1) Digital Smart Marketing Services - providing integrated marketing communication services including brand strategy, content marketing, and media placement; (2) Digital Advertising Services - offering brand advertising, performance advertising, and live streaming operations; (3) Data Technology Product Services - developing AI-powered marketing solutions and SaaS products. The company has evolved from an integrated marketing communications provider into a comprehensive marketing technology service provider.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology is the self-developed Julong Technology Platform, which integrates AI capabilities with big data analytics. Key innovations include OrangeGPT, a series of AI-powered marketing tools utilizing generative AI and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) technology for content creation, image generation, and video scripting. The company employs multi-modal AI generation technology, intelligent video creation platforms, and AI-powered data analysis systems to enhance marketing efficiency and content production at scale.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves automotive industry clients, which accounted for 89.26% of 2024 revenue. Secondary markets include internet information technology and IT communications (8.89%), retail (0.84%), manufacturing (0.45%), and financial services (0.22%). The company serves both direct clients and agency partners, with automotive manufacturers and dealers being the dominant customer base, particularly in new energy vehicle and traditional automotive sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Beijing. It maintains subsidiaries in Shanghai, Tianjin, and Qinhuangdao. The company has established international presence through wholly-owned subsidiaries in the United States (California) and Hong Kong, supporting its emerging overseas business expansion strategy to serve Chinese enterprises going global.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the downstream segment of the marketing services value chain, positioned as a service provider to brand owners and automotive manufacturers. It functions as an intermediary between media platforms (upstream suppliers) and end-brand clients, providing integrated marketing solutions, media buying, and performance optimization services. The company also develops proprietary technology platforms and data products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) AI-driven marketing transformation through OrangeGPT platform enhancement and RAG technology integration; (2) Vertical industry specialization, particularly in automotive new retail and emerging sectors; (3) International expansion and overseas marketing services; (4) Data governance and AI capability enhancement; (5) Development of SaaS products and AI intelligent agents for marketing automation. R&D focuses on multi-modal AI generation, data analysis platforms, and industry-specific knowledge base construction.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through three primary models: (1) Service fees from integrated marketing campaigns and consulting services billed on project or retainer basis; (2) Performance-based advertising fees where clients pay based on measurable advertising results and key performance indicators; (3) Brand advertising placement fees based on media scheduling and execution; (4) Emerging SaaS and data product licensing. Revenue is recognized upon service delivery and client acceptance of completed work.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in a highly competitive, fragmented digital marketing services industry with numerous competitors. The company differentiates itself through: (1) Deep automotive industry expertise and long-term client relationships; (2) Proprietary AI technology platform (OrangeGPT) and data capabilities; (3) Integrated full-chain marketing services from strategy to execution; (4) Team expertise combining AI engineering with vertical industry knowledge. The company positions itself as a technology-driven marketing service provider rather than a traditional agency.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company generated RMB 683.1 million in revenue, representing a 34.88% decline from 2023's RMB 1,048.9 million, reflecting market challenges and customer budget adjustments. The company reported a net loss of RMB 35.1 million (compared to RMB 78.5 million loss in 2023), showing a 55.31% improvement in loss reduction. Total assets reached RMB 733.9 million with shareholder equity of RMB 479.6 million. The company is in a recovery phase after significant 2023 losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's core value proposition centers on AI-powered marketing efficiency and precision targeting. Key differentiators include: (1) OrangeGPT AI platform enabling 90%+ improvement in video editing efficiency and automated content generation; (2) Integrated full-chain marketing capabilities from strategy through execution and optimization; (3) Vertical industry expertise in automotive with deep understanding of new retail transformation; (4) Data-driven approach combining consumer insights with AI-powered decision support; (5) Proprietary technology reducing client marketing costs while improving campaign effectiveness and ROI measurement.
